reviews.name: Martha Razo
reviews.text: I've been getting my lashes at Mia Lashes CA for about 6 months. Erlym does a beautiful job, my lashes last a long time. She is very polite and professional.

reviews.name: Maria Martin
reviews.text: I loved them, they look very natural, nothing exaggerated. I was very happy with your work, thank you.

reviews.name: Le Martin
reviews.text: Erlym is the kindest and pays attention to detail. I highly recommend Mia Lashes. Great quality, prices and the lashes stay fresh and last a long time.

reviews.name: Bon Bon
reviews.text: I love Erlym's work. I came in for BB Glow and she was very honest with me. I came back for lash extensions and they turned out great.
